heroText: Manila works best as a base in Philippines when you anchor days around Intramuros, Rizal Park and Fort Santiago. Use those sights to understand the city's history, street life and visitor rhythm. Manila Ninoy Aquino handles the main arrival flow, so hotel choice should balance the centre, transfer time and day-trip plans.
